description: Kayaking teaches safe paddling: hazards and first aid, Safety Afloat, life jackets and safety gear, kayak and paddle design and care, wet exits and rescues, and the strokes and maneuvers of a solo paddler.

safety.note: Paddling follows Safety Afloat under a qualified supervisor, and you must pass the swimmer test first.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirement 2 is the swimmer test, which must be completed before requirements 3 through 8. Confirm sub-item lettering on the official page.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Hazards, first aid and Safety Afloat
requirements.summary: Likely paddling hazards, first aid for common injuries, and the Safety Afloat policy.

requirements.title: The swimmer test
requirements.summary: Passing the Scouting America swimmer test before the on-water requirements.

requirements.title: Life jackets and safety gear
requirements.summary: Choosing and fitting a life jacket, and gear such as a signal device, spare paddle and throw bag.

requirements.title: Kayak design and care
requirements.summary: Parts of a kayak, the main kinds of kayaks, and care and storage.

requirements.title: Paddles
requirements.summary: Paddle parts, sizing, use and care.

requirements.title: Capsize and rescue
requirements.summary: Wet exits, assisted reentry, a kayak-over-kayak rescue, the HELP position, and swimming a kayak to shore.

requirements.title: Strokes
requirements.summary: The basic solo strokes, such as forward, back, sweep and draw.

requirements.title: Maneuvers
requirements.summary: Paddling straight, turning, moving sideways, stopping, reversing and a figure-eight course.
